text.en:
Thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry you're dealing with a termination of your employment. Don't worry, I'll help you draft a notice to your employer for a possible reinstatement and/or higher compensation.

Please answer a few questions so I can make the notice specific for your facts. The entire session would require approximately 15-20 mins of your attention.

This is not a legal service or legal advice, always consult a legal advisor for any legal help.

Reply yes when you have read and understood the above.
Have you understood that this is a strict question-answer session and not general legal advice?
As per the description on equaljustice.ai, you are not entitled to a refund when declining to proceed. Your session is over now. You can exit or start a new session.
What would you like to create?
What is the full legal name of your employer / company?
What is your full name as per your employment records?
On what date were you terminated, retrenched, or forced to resign? (DD-MM-YYYY or approximate)
Briefly describe what relief you want (e.g. reinstatement, compensation, gratuity, PF dues).

explanation.en: Be specific — this will appear in your notice.

text.en: Thank you for completing all the questions. To receive your personalized notice or complaint, please complete the payment.
Your session is over now. You can exit or start a new session. You can reach out to equal@equaljustice.ai for further support including connecting with a lawyer.
